tools.name: find_direct_buses
tools.description: Find direct buses (Premium, City Direct, ShareTransport) in Singapore that stop near an office/destination. Give the office as office_area (a name or slug from list_areas, e.g. "Raffles Place", "one-north") or as office_lat/office_lng. Optionally give home as home_area (a neighbourhood like "Punggol

tools.name: get_bus
tools.description: Get full details for one direct bus service: all route stops with estimated arrival times, fare, operator contact, operator timetable or booking link, schedule (AM and PM runs) and the directbus.sg page URL. Accepts a service number (e.g. "776", "SKM1", "BA 2 (AM)") or a URL slug (e.g. "ba-2-am", "s

tools.name: nearest_stops
tools.description: Find the nearest direct-bus pickup stops to a location in Singapore. Returns up to 10 stops with the buses that stop there and walking distance in metres.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: List all office areas (CBD, business parks) served by direct buses, and all residential neighbourhoods that have direct buses. Includes coordinates and directbus.sg page URLs. Use this to discover what areas exist and get coordinates to pass to find_direct_buses.
